pages.text: Oh. You're the new one. I'm &6Odessa Quill&r. Don't touch the jar that hums. Everything here has a story; some are even true.
Most of my wares are for collectors. But I keep something special: &6pets&r. One for each trade, and they grow as you do, earning stats and perks as they level.
I only give an egg to someone who's shown they can look after one. Reach &6Combat 3&r, and a certain egg is yours.
